bluf: Posture Normal. Nothing in the last 24 hours touches a WashU asset: no NWS product, no WashU Alert or Ring 1 violent incident, no local health advisory, no outage; dry and warming through Friday. The one decision today is cyber: the BYOD ransomware group has hit three universities with academic medical centers since late September (Vanderbilt Nov 9, Michigan State, UNM Health) and this is the last fully staffed week before Thanksgiving break (Nov 25-29), so task IT Security and the BJC liaison today. This week: pre-script a WashU Alert for exam-season hoax threats, confirm MMR documentation posture before travel, scope federal awards exposed to the Dec 11 funding deadline, and plan around a stacked downtown Saturday Nov 21.
